title: Component Queries
statement:
Label connected components with DFS and answer membership and size queries.

Input
n m q, then m undirected edges. SAME u v asks whether u and v are connected. SIZE u asks how many vertices belong to u’s component.

Output
Print YES or NO for SAME and one size for SIZE.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000, 0 ≤ m ≤ 200000. Endpoints are in [1,n]. Parallel edges and self-loops are allowed. 1 ≤ q ≤ 200000.
